en: The postcard features a wintry mountain landscape with snow-covered ground and several buildings in the foreground, all set against the dramatic peaks of the Dolomites. The prominent mountains are labeled with their names and elevations (C.a Pradidali - m. 2750, C.a di Sedole - m. 2406). At the bottom, it mentions 'Dolomiti di Primiero - Val Canali - Villa Welspergh (m. 1042)'. The image is tinted in blue and white, suggesting an old photographic style.
